acquisition.completion: First valid GPS callback or NMEA fix completes one acquisition. Unavailable NMEA access does not block GPS updates.

validation.gps: Require the GPS provider, finite coordinates within latitude/longitude bounds, and a recent original elapsedRealtimeNanos timestamp.
validation.nmea: Validate the checksum, fix status, coordinates, message timestamp, and original UTC fix time.

lifecycle.late_callbacks: Generation checks suppress callbacks from completed or cancelled acquisitions.
lifecycle.failure: Keep the previous weather and retry after five minutes.
